verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer offers a first-party programmatic surface: an OAuth-authenticated hosted MCP server, confirmed live by runtime probes, that runs Computer tasks with thread continuation, progress notifications, file uploads, approval of sensitive actions, clarification relays and mid-task connector auth, plus an admin Analytics API. Nothing documents that this surface matches everything the UI can do, and task access is only through an MCP tool rather than a general API. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented programmatic management of connectors, settings and workspace beyond task delegation, and independent hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.

If Computer needs to connect to a service mid-task, it returns an `auth_required` event, and after authentication the conversation resumes on the same thread
